overview_description.description:
RigPlenish is a software company that develops a data management application. provides an end-to-end data management application that automates paperwork at each stage of an ambulance run. It offers RigPlenish, an application that reduces the time spent by paramedics filling out paperwork. The company’s product collects real-time data from WiFi enabled devices on ambulances; assign each patient's data to patient through barcode technology; and analyze the data to improve time discrepancies and make ambulances more efficient. Additionally, it charges a fee to automate checklists and compliance while improving communication between ambulance hubs and hospitals.

RigPlenish was founded by Nupur Mehta and Tejaswi Sagiraju in 2015; and is headquartered in Cupertino, California.
